# SpecWeave

> SpecWeave is an open-source CLI (npm package `specweave`, MIT) that keeps AI coding work in git as one short spec.md per piece of work, an append-only task ledger and a handoff. When Claude Code, Codex or another agent hits a usage limit, `specweave handoff` records the state and pushes the uncommitted edits, and `specweave pickup` continues it in Codex, Grok Build, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot or a second account of the same tool. One AGENTS.md of about 760 tokens is the instruction file every agent reads.

SpecWithCode (pronounced "Spec with Code"; free, source available, independently maintained; product page https://spec-weave.com/code/, downloads for Apple silicon Macs, Windows 10 and 11 and Linux at https://spec-weave.com/code/download/) is the workspace built on that record: one place for project agents (like Claude Code Projects), personal agents (like OpenAI Dots or Hermes; SpecWithCode's Personal projects have memory, plans, scheduled routines, a Telegram channel to the coordinator and optional read-only Google access) and coding agents. A project has a coordinator and workers, each on its own coding agent and model (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot and others), running on machines the user owns, reached over the local network, SSH or Tailscale.

Install: `npm install -g specweave`, then `specweave init` in a repository.

## Start here

- [What is SpecWeave?](https://spec-weave.com/docs/overview/introduction/): the spec, the ledger and the handoff in one page
- [SpecWithCode](https://spec-weave.com/code/): the free AI coding agent workspace: a coordinator and worker threads per project, usage limits and fallbacks, your own machines
- [Download SpecWithCode](https://spec-weave.com/code/download/): free notarized .dmg for Apple silicon (macOS 13+), a Windows 10 and 11 installer, and a Linux AppImage and .deb, with install steps
- [SpecWithCode overview](https://spec-weave.com/docs/overview/studio/): every AI agent in one workspace on your own machines
- [How it works](https://spec-weave.com/docs/overview/how-it-works/): the daily loop from spec to closed increment
- [Installation](https://spec-weave.com/docs/getting-started/installation/): install, update, uninstall
- [Your first increment](https://spec-weave.com/docs/getting-started/first-increment/)

## Switching tools and accounts

- [Handoff and pickup](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/cross-tool-handoff/): continue a task in another tool when a usage limit hits, including auto-handoff at 95 percent
- [Claude Code Projects and threads](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/claude-code-projects/): one thread is one increment
- [Codex, Grok Build, Cursor and Gemini CLI](https://spec-weave.com/docs/integrations/generic-ai-tools/): what each tool reads
- [Auto-handoff rules](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/auto-handoff/): the heads-up at 95 percent of a Claude Code or Codex usage window, the handoff it writes by itself when a turn hits the limit, and the local checkpoints it saves between turns
- [What goes in handoff.md](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/handoff-md/): the fields of an AI agent handoff, a template, and how to generate it
- [Switch from Claude Code to OpenCode mid-task](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/switch-claude-code-to-opencode/): what OpenCode reads (AGENTS.md, skills) and the two commands
- [Switch from Claude Code to Cursor mid-task](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/switch-claude-code-to-cursor/): Cursor's AGENTS.md, rules and skill folders, and the two commands
- [Switch from Claude Code to Codex without losing your place](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/switch-claude-code-to-codex/): the two commands, what carries over, and switching back
- [Claude Code usage limit reached: what to do next](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/claude-code-usage-limit/): how the five-hour and weekly limits work and every way to keep going
- [Claude Code vs Codex](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/claude-code-vs-codex/): differences that matter day to day, and switching when a limit hits
- [AGENTS.md vs CLAUDE.md](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/agents-md-vs-claude-md/): one instruction file for every coding agent
- [SpecWeave 3.0](https://spec-weave.com/docs/guides/specweave-3/): what changed from 2.x and how to upgrade

## Teams of 2–10 people

- [Pricing for teams of 2–10](https://spec-weave.com/pricing/): SpecWeave and SpecWithCode are built for teams of 2–10 people and free; the SpecWeave CLI is MIT licensed; private skills on Verified Skill from $20 a month; a $990 founding team pilot that sets up handoff between Claude Code and Codex
